name: Chickenhare and the treasure of Spiking-Beard
name_original: Chickenhare and the treasure of Spiking-Beard
description:
Adventure is calling! Join Chickenhare and his friends on an unforgettable quest to find the 7 crystals before Spiking-Beard and save the Kingdoms from Chaos. Explore magical lands, solve clever puzzles, uncover hidden secrets — and who knows? Maybe you’ll discover the path to a real-life treasure. A heart-pounding adventure for kids and parents alike — are you ready to become a true Treasure Hunter?  

Three heroes, one unstoppable team  

Chickenhare won’t be alone in this adventure: he can count on his friends, and their special abilities, to overcome any challenges in your path. 

  • Chickenhare soars through the air, using his ears to glide past obstacles and reach new heights.  

  • Abe might be a little bit too cautious sometimes, but you can always count on him and his shell to destroy vulnerable structures and clear your way.  

  • Meg is the master of martial arts – she kicks, jumps, and even do both at the same time to reach higher places and even has a secret twist if she’s surrounded by a mob of enemies.   

Together, nothing will stop them! Their combined skills will help you to solve intricate puzzles, dodge traps, clear your way, and take down enemies in a smooth, strategic character-swapping. Slide down slopes, zip-line, smash through walls, lasso enemies and objects, collect items to traverse vibrant worlds filled with secrets. Every encounter demands smart thinking and quick reflexes—are you ready to harness the strengths of the ultimate trio and stop Spiking Beard before it’s too late? 

Explore the Kingdom of Featherbeard  

Travel through a series of breathtaking locations, each bursting with charm, danger and mystery. From the majestic halls of Featherbeard’s Castle to the shadowy depths of Demon’s Hole, every place is packed with secrets to uncover, treasures to find, and surprises – good or bad - to keep you exploring. Stunning visuals and creative level design introduce an all-new original adventure set in the Chickenhare universe, in addition to the movies and comics, and for the first time in a video game. 

The thrill of a one-of-a-kind treasure hunt  

Uncover hidden treasures and solve puzzles in a treasure hunt like no other. The game’s innovative treasure-hunting mechanics will go beyond the virtual world: solve in-game mysteries to unlock clues for a real-world treasure hunt. So stay sharp, don’t miss anything, and get ready for the adventure of a lifetime. 

Accessible fun with layers of depth  

Whether you’re a first-time adventurer or a seasoned treasure hunter, Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking Beard is an action-pack journey for everyone. Accessible controls and humor-filled storytelling draw you into its vibrant world, while layered challenges, clever puzzles, and thrilling battles provide depth for players craving a truly engaging adventure. It’s a game designed to captivate and entertain every kind of explorer. And we highly encourage apprentice adventurers to seek for the guidance of their parents to triumph! 

Animated Charm Brought to Life  

Embark on a brand-new adventure set in the exciting world of Chickenhare, inspired by the beloved animated movies and comic books. Featuring familiar characters, whimsical humor, and an original story full of surprises, the game expands the universe with an all-new journey. Add to those colorful, hand-crafted environments and beautifully animated visuals, and you’ve got an adventure that’s as delightful to watch as it is to play.  

Are you ready for the adventure of your life? We’re waiting for you!

Processor: Intel i5 7600k / AMD Ryzen 5 1500x
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1080 / AMD Radeon RX Verga 64 or better
